fields.description: Broker host name or IP, without scheme or port (for example rabbitmq.example.com).
fields.label: Host
fields.name: host

fields.description: AMQP port. Usually 5672, or 5671 with TLS.
fields.label: Port
fields.name: port

fields.description: Virtual host name. Leave empty for the default "/".
fields.label: Virtual Host
fields.name: vhost

fields.description: Connect with TLS. Most hosted brokers require this.
fields.label: Use TLS (amqps)
fields.name: useTls

fields.description: Optional. Base URL of the RabbitMQ Management plugin (for example http://localhost:15672). Uses the same username and password.
fields.label: Management API URL
fields.name: managementUrl

auth.method: Provider connection fields; API key or access token
